title: Places
descriptionFa: here و there، بالا و پایین و وسط، چپ و راست، و خونه یا بیرون یا خارج.

words.tipFa: بدون to: come here، نه come to here.

words.example: Have you been to Yazd? I'm going there in April.
There are books and papers everywhere in my room.
We climbed to the top of the mountain.
Don't stand in the middle of the road!
There's some sugar at the bottom of the glass.
I always sit at the front of the class.
words.tipFa: the front of = بخش جلویی خود چیز. in front of = روبه‌روی چیزی.

words.example: The children are sitting in the back of the car.
Unit 3 is at the beginning of the book.
The cinema is on the left, next to the bank.
In Iran, cars drive on the right.

words.tipFa: بدون the: at home، نه at the home.

words.example: Sorry, she's out. She'll be back in ten minutes.
My neighbours are away for two weeks.
My brother works abroad, in Canada.
words.tipFa: بدون to: go abroad، نه go to abroad.
